Team —

Quick background: following the Q1 calibration and a couple of close-probation conversations, we need to make a short-term adjustment for two individual contributors on the Eng Ops team (Ana R. and Dev S.). The goal is to: 1) reduce context switching for the interim manager; 2) provide focused coaching during probation; and 3) keep escalation paths clear for customer-impact issues.

Proposed approach (60-day window):
- Reassign Ana R. and Dev S. to report to Marissa (day-to-day) effective Monday 3/29.
- Marcus to cover weekly skip-levels and own any customer escalations that require exec input.
- Lauren to run a twice-weekly coaching session for the first 3 weeks (shadow + role play) using a standard probation coaching template.
- Priyom / People Ops to log the change as a temporary reporting reroute (no permanent status change) and prepare update to their probation plans.

I attached a coaching template to speed us up — please review and flag anything sensitive (compensation notes, PIP language) that should not be shared directly with the ICs yet.

Requests:
- Marissa: can you confirm capacity to take the two reports and propose a cadence for 1:1s?
- Marcus: confirm willingness to own skip-levels + escalation on-call.
- Priyom / Kelly: can People Ops prepare the necessary temporary assignment documentation and an HR checklist we can share with the managers?

I want to keep this tight and confidential until we brief the two ICs. If you have alternative suggestions, call them out now.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
